ACIB (Action-Conditioned Information Bottleneck)：IB 驱动的 token-level importance scoring for compact VLAs。**关键发现：joint training 会通过梯度污染损坏 base policy → decoupled training 是必须的 architectural constraint；scorer-only (v7.1) 容量不足仅产生 global bias → 需解冻 connector 参与 representation learning (v7.2)。** Backbone: SmolVLA (64 tokens, 960-dim, PixelShuffle=4)。评测: LIBERO 4 suites。

- Core insight: IB auxiliary loss 在 compact VLA 中造成 gradient pollution → decoupled training 是必须方案

- Method: log-barrier contrastive loss + connector+scorer decoupled training + residual soft modulation
- Primary contributions: interpretability (action-conditioned importance maps) + robustness (perturbation)
- Secondary: efficiency (token pruning)
- Failure taxonomy (v1-v7.1) 作为 analysis section
